tldr: Evening batch, Aug 18: Anthropic's annualized revenue hit $65B (~7x YoY) with a first adjusted operating profit — an IPO could land this fall at ~$1T, beating OpenAI to market. OpenAI doubles down on education with ChatGPT for Teens and a CodeAI literacy partnership, while the DOJ probes a16z over interlocking Databricks/Fivetran board seats. Research: Penn State finds context compaction silently drops 83% of user guardrails, and a JAMA piece argues regulators shouldn't mandate a human in the loop. Models: Tencent's open-weight UI-Mate-27B GUI agent, GPT-5.6 Sol praised as OpenAI's best vision model, Qwen3.8-27B claiming frontier intelligence on a single 5090, and DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 numbers from a Strix Halo box. Hermes Agent raises ChatGPT/Codex limits to 900K and ships CUA for all models; Amodei defends his messaging, doubling down on the 5–10 year disease-cure thesis.

articles.title: Anthropic's Annualized Revenue Tops $65B, IPO Possible This Fall
articles.summary: Annualized revenue hit $65B by end-July — ~7x YoY — with first adjusted operating profit; IPO could land this fall at ~$1T, beating OpenAI to market.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT for Teens
articles.summary: A ChatGPT tier for ages 13–17 with stronger built-in protections, healthy-use features, and added parental controls — an education-market play.

articles.title: OpenAI Partners With CodeAI to Prepare the First AI Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI and CodeAI team up to build AI literacy in schools — critical thinking about AI and skills to use and shape it responsibly.

articles.title: DOJ Probes a16z Over Interlocking AI Board Seats
articles.summary: Justice Dept examines whether a16z partners on Databricks and Fivetran boards breach the Clayton Act ban on interlocking directorates.

articles.title: AI Systems Silently Drop 83% of User Rules When Compressing Context
articles.summary: Penn State: context compaction discards ~83% of guardrails like "don't email without approval"; a Qwen3.5-9B add-on preserves 90%+.

articles.title: JAMA: Regulators Shouldn't Force a Human Into the Loop
articles.summary: JAMA opinion piece: autonomous AI will soon beat doctor-AI teams, so regulators shouldn't mandate a doctor's final say — though most evidence is simulations.

articles.title: GPT-5.6 Sol Called OpenAI's Best Vision Model Yet
articles.summary: Roboflow's hands-on review crowns GPT-5.6 Sol OpenAI's strongest vision model — a 339-point Hacker News thread on the multimodal gains.

articles.title: Tencent's UI-Mate-27B: Open-Weight GUI Agent for Long-Horizon Tasks
articles.summary: Open-weight foundation GUI agent that watches live screenshots and drives mouse/keyboard — long-horizon work across apps and OSes.

articles.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 Benchmarked on Strix Halo
articles.summary: A week of V4-Flash-0731 numbers on a Strix Halo box (128GB unified): draft-model tuning, n_max sweeps, and a launch line that actually lifts tokens/s.

articles.title: Qwen3.8-27B: Frontier Intelligence on a Single RTX 5090
articles.summary: Alibaba: the 27B dense open model delivers frontier-level intelligence on one 5090 — the local-AI inflection point, per the Qwen team.

articles.title: Hermes Agent Raises ChatGPT/Codex Subscription Limits to 900K
articles.summary: BYO-subscription users get far more headroom as Hermes Agent expands access to frontier models through ChatGPT/Codex subscriptions.

articles.title: Hermes Agent Ships Computer Use (CUA) Out of the Box for All Models
articles.summary: Computer-use support now works with every model in Hermes Agent by default — no per-model setup needed.

articles.title: Amodei Defends His AI Messaging, Doubles Down on Disease-Cure Thesis
articles.summary: Amodei rejects claims his AI messaging is too negative, reiterates his disease-cure thesis (5–10 years), and backs open-weights-friendly testing exemptions.
